route_reports_comment_check.name: route_reports_comment_check
route_reports_comment_check.value: "route_reports"."comment" is null or (("route_reports"."reason" in ('place_changed', 'other')) and btrim("route_reports"."comment") <> '' and char_length("route_reports"."comment") <= 80)

route_reports_comment_required_check.name: route_reports_comment_required_check
route_reports_comment_required_check.value: "route_reports"."comment" is not null or not ("route_reports"."reason" in ('other'))

steps_highlights_check.name: steps_highlights_check
steps_highlights_check.value:
"steps"."highlights" is null or (array_ndims("steps"."highlights") = 1
        and cardinality("steps"."highlights") between 1 and 3
        and array_position("steps"."highlights", null) is null
        and array_position("steps"."highlights", '') is null)

steps_audio_check.name: steps_audio_check
steps_audio_check.value:
("steps"."audio_path" is null and "steps"."audio_duration_s" is null)
        or ("steps"."audio_path" is not null and "steps"."audio_duration_s" is not null and "steps"."audio_duration_s" > 0)
